# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within Rux, please do not file a public issue.

Instead, please send an email to the maintainers or report it privately through GitHub Security Advisories:
- Email: `security@qumi.tech` or open a private security advisory on GitHub.

Please provide:
- A description of the vulnerability.
- Minimal reproducible example (`.rx` file).
- The affected operating system, architecture, and Rux version.

We will acknowledge receipt within 48 hours and work on a fix promptly.
